rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a medicinal drug.

example.english: I took medicine, and my headache isn't as bad now.
example.traditional: 我食咗藥，個頭冇咁痛喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 zo2 joek6 go3 tau4 mou5 gam3 tung3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a treatment or cure rather than for the drug itself.

example.english: This treatment is pretty good medicine for joint pain.
example.traditional: 呢種治療對關節痛幾有效。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 zi6 liu4 deoi3 gwaan1 zit3 tung3 gei2 jau5 haau6

rows.note: Use this for medicine as an academic and scientific field of study.

example.english: They studied medicine at university and became a doctor after graduating.
example.traditional: 佢大學讀醫學，畢業後做咗醫生。
example.jyutping: keoi5 daai6 hok6 duk6 ji1 hok6 bat1 jip6 hau6 zou6 zo2 ji1 sang1

rows.note: Use this when medicine means the medical profession or its professional community.

example.english: People in medicine have been paying close attention to this new virus recently.
example.traditional: 醫學界最近好關注呢種新病毒。
example.jyutping: ji1 hok6 gaai3 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 gwaan1 zyu3 ni1 zung2 san1 beng6 duk6
